dtalk-ecosystem.title: D-Talk Ecosystem
dtalk-ecosystem.subtitle: Fashion Marketplace
dtalk-ecosystem.description: Frontend for a fashion-tech marketplace connecting designers, brands, and buyers. Features a canvas-based product customizer and role-specific dashboards for 4 user types.
dtalk-ecosystem.longDescription: Built the frontend for a multi-role fashion e-commerce platform. The app lets designers upload and sell their work, brands browse and purchase designs, and admins manage the ecosystem. Includes a browser-based design editor (Konva.js) for real-time product customization across multiple print areas.
dtalk-ecosystem.problem: Fashion designers needed a platform to sell digital designs directly to brands, and brands needed a way to customize and order products without back-and-forth.
dtalk-ecosystem.solution: Built a multi-role platform with separate dashboards for designers, brands, and admins. Added a real-time canvas editor for product customization with live previews.
dtalk-ecosystem.content:
D-Talk is a multi-role e-commerce platform for the fashion industry, connecting designers, brands, and consumers.

## The Challenge

Designers needed a way to sell digital designs online. Brands needed to discover designs and customize products without manual back-and-forth. The existing workflow was slow and fragmented.

## The Solution

### Multi-Role Architecture

Four user roles, each with their own dashboard:

- **Designers**: Upload and sell visual assets, track earnings
- **Fashion Designers**: Create technical fashion blueprints
- **Brands**: Browse, purchase designs, manage production
- **Admins**: User management and content moderation

### Design Studio

A browser-based editor built with Fabric.js and Konva for real-time product customization. Users apply designs to print areas across multiple views (front, back, sleeves).

### E-Commerce

Full marketplace with sample/bulk orders, payment processing via Konnect, order tracking, and shopping cart.

## Technical Stack

- **Next.js App Router** with Server Actions
- **Zustand** for design studio state, **TanStack Query** for server state
- **HTTP-only cookie auth** with role-based middleware
keyFeatures: Canvas-based design editor with Fabric.js and Konva
AI-assisted design generation and custom uploads
Full e-commerce system with cart, favorites, and payments
Earnings tracking and withdrawal system for creators
HTTP-only cookie auth with JWT and role-based access control
Azure Blob Storage for image management

ecommerce-platform.title: Vertex
ecommerce-platform.subtitle: Tech Gadgets Store
ecommerce-platform.description: Full-stack e-commerce platform with product catalog, flash sales, persistent cart, Stripe payments, and an admin dashboard for inventory management.
ecommerce-platform.longDescription: End-to-end e-commerce app for tech gadgets. Includes a customer-facing storefront with filtering, flash sales with countdown timers, and persistent shopping carts. Admin dashboard handles product CRUD, order tracking, and inventory. Built with Domain-Driven Design architecture.
ecommerce-platform.problem: Needed a modern, full-featured e-commerce platform that could handle product variants, flash sales, and integrated payments without relying on third-party platforms.
ecommerce-platform.solution: Built a complete storefront and admin dashboard with Stripe integration, persistent carts, and flash sale support.
impact: Fast page loads with edge caching
ecommerce-platform.content:
Vertex is a full-stack e-commerce platform for tech products, built with Next.js and clean architecture principles.

## The Challenge

Small retailers need modern storefronts without the cost and lock-in of enterprise platforms. They want product management, payments, and analytics under their control.

## The Solution

### Storefront

Product catalog with filtering across Audio, Camera, Gaming, Smartphones, and SmartWatches. Flash sales with live countdown timers. Persistent cart state across sessions. Stripe Checkout for payments.

### Admin Dashboard

Product CRUD with inventory tracking, dynamic categories, order management, and role-based access control.

## Technical Stack

Built on Next.js 14 with App Router, React 19, Domain-Driven Design. Authentication via NextAuth.js v5 with Google Provider. Stripe webhooks for payment fulfillment.
keyFeatures: Flash sales with live countdown timers
Admin dashboard with product and order management

project-management-app.title: Planner
project-management-app.subtitle: Project Management App
project-management-app.description: Project management tool with Kanban boards, burn-down charts, team calendars, and a collaborative whiteboard. Built as a full-featured productivity suite.
project-management-app.longDescription: A productivity app combining project management, calendar scheduling, and visual collaboration tools. Features drag-and-drop Kanban boards, recurring events, role-based teams, and an integrated whiteboard and diagramming tool with Mermaid.js.
project-management-app.problem: Teams use separate tools for tasks, scheduling, and brainstorming — Trello, Google Calendar, Miro. Switching between them wastes time.
project-management-app.solution: Combined Kanban boards, calendars, whiteboards, and diagram tools into a single app with team management and permissions.
impact: Kanban + Calendar + Whiteboard in one app
project-management-app.content:
Planner is a project management and planning app built with Next.js.

## The Challenge

Teams juggle multiple tools — Trello, Google Calendar, Miro, docs. Context switching between them reduces productivity.

## The Solution

### Project Management

- **Kanban Boards**: Drag-and-drop with @dnd-kit and custom columns
- **Burn Down Charts**: Sprint tracking with Chart.js
- **Multiple Views**: Toggle between text and board views

### Team & Calendar

- **Teams**: Create teams, assign roles (Admin, Manager, Member)
- **Calendar**: Monthly/Weekly/Daily views with recurring events
- **Quick Capture**: Sparks widget for fast idea capture

### Visual Collaboration

- **Whiteboard**: Built with perfect-freehand and roughjs
- **Diagrams**: Mermaid.js with live preview
keyFeatures: Mermaid.js diagram editor with live preview

menu-qr.title: Menu QR
menu-qr.subtitle: Digital Restaurant Menu
menu-qr.description: SaaS platform for restaurants to create and manage digital menus accessible via QR code. Includes an onboarding wizard, drag-and-drop menu editor, and analytics dashboard.
menu-qr.longDescription: Full-stack SaaS for digital restaurant menus. Restaurant owners create their menu through an 8-step setup wizard, manage it with a hierarchical drag-and-drop editor, and share it via customizable QR codes. Built with NestJS backend and Next.js frontend, with multilingual support including Arabic RTL.
menu-qr.problem: Restaurants needed a simple way to create contactless digital menus that they could update in real-time, without reprinting costs or technical skills.
menu-qr.solution: Built an end-to-end platform with guided onboarding, a visual menu editor, customizable QR codes, and an analytics dashboard.
impact: Multi-language support (EN, FR, AR with RTL)
menu-qr.content:
Menu QR is a SaaS platform for digital restaurant menus, built with Next.js and NestJS.

## The Challenge

Restaurants deal with expensive menu reprints, the need for contactless service, and serving multilingual customers — all without technical resources.

## The Solution

### Onboarding

8-step wizard: slug claiming, subscription selection, template choice, social media links, and menu setup.

### Menu Editor

- **Hierarchical structure**: Menus → Categories → Items
- **Drag-and-drop** reordering with @dnd-kit
- **Rich details**: Name, description, price, images, dietary info, allergens
- **Image optimization**: Client-side compression to WebP
- **Live preview** with template switching

### Analytics

View metrics, QR scan patterns, and menu engagement with daily/weekly/monthly reporting.

## Technical Stack

### Backend (NestJS)
- JWT auth with Google OAuth 2.0
- Redis caching with cache-aside pattern
- Swagger API docs

### Frontend (Next.js)
- next-intl with RTL support for Arabic
- Optimistic UI updates
- Image compression and lazy loading
keyFeatures: Drag-and-drop menu editor with hierarchical organization
Real-time menu updates — edit prices, hide items during service
Multilingual support with RTL for Arabic
Analytics dashboard with scan and engagement tracking
Customizable QR codes with PDF export
Image optimization with client-side WebP compression
JWT and OAuth 2.0 authentication with role-based access

kindra-ecommerce.title: KINDRA
kindra-ecommerce.subtitle: Fashion E-Commerce Starter
kindra-ecommerce.description: Production-ready e-commerce starter kit for fashion. Separate Men's and Women's storefronts, multi-variant products (size/color), Stripe payments, and a full admin dashboard.
kindra-ecommerce.longDescription: A SaaS starter kit for launching fashion e-commerce sites. Features separate Men's and Women's collections, multi-variant product support, Stripe checkout, and a complete admin suite. Runs on Docker with Cloudflare R2 for image storage.
kindra-ecommerce.problem: Starting a fashion e-commerce site from scratch takes months. Multi-variant products, payments, and image storage add complexity.
kindra-ecommerce.solution: Built a ready-to-deploy starter kit with all the common features baked in — storefronts, admin, payments, and image hosting.
impact: Ready to deploy out of the box
Dual image storage (Cloudflare R2 + Vercel Blob)
Custom session-based auth with OAuth support
kindra-ecommerce.content:
KINDRA is a full-stack e-commerce starter kit for fashion, built with Next.js 15 and PostgreSQL.

## The Challenge

Fashion e-commerce has specific needs: multi-variant products (sizes, colors), high-quality images, and separate catalogs for different collections. Building all of this takes time.

## The Solution

### Architecture

- **Frontend**: Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS with custom design system
- **Backend**: Server Actions with PostgreSQL and Drizzle ORM
- **Auth**: Custom session-based auth with Oslo, OAuth support
- **Infra**: Docker, Cloudflare R2, Vercel

### Features

- **Multi-section shopping**: Men's and Women's collections
- **Product discovery**: Dynamic routing, filtering, search
- **Checkout**: Stripe with webhook fulfillment
- **Admin**: Product management, order processing, inventory
keyFeatures: Admin dashboard for inventory and orders
Image storage with Cloudflare R2 and Vercel Blob
